units.source_text: 他本是港口的流浪汉，过去难免有动刀动棒的时候，

en.t: He had originally been a drifter from the port, and in the past there had inevitably been times when he resorted to knives or clubs,

units.source_text: 然而自从来到这个山村，讨了一个带着孩子的女人做老婆，

en.t: but after coming to this mountain village and taking as his wife a woman who already had a child,

units.source_text: 而且对这个孩子又产生了感情。

en.t: he also grew attached to the child.

units.source_text: 他自然而然地觉得要在这块土地上度过终生，

en.t: Quite naturally, he came to feel that he would spend the rest of his life on this land,

units.source_text: 便决意在此安家落户了。

en.t: and so he resolved to settle down here and make it his home.
